description: A five-minute proof that the account's owner passed their second factor, for the venue's vault: send it as the x-step-up header of POST /vault/withdraw (api.taifoon.dev/vault/withdraw) with your key. Minted only for an account that has a second factor set up (in the deck, by its owner) and is unlocked right now with agents allowed; a key with no second factor cannot withdraw from the venue at all.
name: step_up_receipt
